   - Maximum exposure to loss at Dec 31 2024: Loan receivable €1,440.8M + Advance payments €1,415.7M + Equity €903.0M + AR €70.8M ≈ €3,830M off-balance-sheet risk in an unconsolidated VIE.
   - Two active loan agreements (2021: up to €1B, €912.4M drawn; 2024: up to €1B, €610M drawn) with below-market interest (capped at 1%), 10-year terms, 3-year grace — a form of hidden leverage/subsidy to the sole supplier.
   - ASML also committed to guarantee Carl Zeiss SMT a minimum free cash flow floor via prepayments — further hidden quasi-guarantee exposure.
   - 2024 purchases from Carl Zeiss SMT: €3,946.5M (up from €3,325.9M in 2023).

2. CAPEX 2025: ASML guides ~€2.0B capex for facility expansion, self-funded.

3. No AI lab investments, no SPVs, no hyperscaler compute agreements, no revenue roundtripping identified in this section. The filing is a traditional semiconductor equipment manufacturer — SIFI relevance is concentrated entirely in the Carl Zeiss SMT relationship.
